sets.relationshipLabel: a creature and the thing that belongs to it
sets.explanation: Each creature is defined by the thing it guards or lives in — a dragon's hoard, a fox's den.

sets.relationshipLabel: a humble or cursed origin transformed by magic into its result
sets.explanation: Magic turns a lowly origin into its grander result — pumpkin becomes carriage, frog becomes prince.

sets.relationshipLabel: a kind of figure and one of them by name
sets.explanation: Each named figure is simply a specific instance of the broader fairy-tale role above it.

sets.relationshipLabel: the one property or utterance a magical thing can never have
sets.explanation: Each object's magic is defined by the very thing it categorically lacks — dust with no weight, a mirror that cannot lie.

glossary.definition: A wild-haired old woman from Slavic folktales who lives deep in the forest in a hut that stands on chicken legs.
